duration.text: The Short-term Chinese Training Program at Harbin University of Science and Technology is a 4 Weeks long program for international students, taught in Chinese.

fees.text: Application Fee: $ 150 USD Service Fee: $ 50 USD Tuition fee: $ 277 USD/In total ￥ 2000 CNY/In total

materials.text: 1.Photocopy of valid passport With photo, passport number &expiration date and name included. 2.Passport-sized photo A passport-sized photo taken recently of the applicant.

requirements.text: The applicants for Short-term Chinese Training Program should be a group of more than 5 people, and all of them should have a good health, without the age limit.
